<ApiTitle method="get" title="Get Audit Trail" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/turbosign/documents/{documentId}/audit-trail"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every recorded event on a document in time order, such as sent, viewed, signed and voided, with the person who acted. Entries form a hash chain, so each `currentHash` builds on the previous entry's hash and tampering would break the chain.
